trap.label: inversão
trap.wrong: Were the mayor offers a review, the union would return.
trap.right: Were the mayor to offer a review, the union would return.
trap.why: Em português “caso o prefeito ofereça” usa o subjuntivo. Em inglês, a inversão com Were exige to + infinitivo (Were … to).

mcq.q: “___ the union accept, we would sign.”
“___ talks begun earlier, the strike would not have happened.”
“___ both sides move, there is no deal.”

fix.wrong: Should the union accepts, we would sign.
fix.right: Should the union accept, we would sign.

fix.wrong: Had the talks began earlier, the strike would not have happened.
fix.right: Had the talks begun earlier, the strike would not have happened.

fix.wrong: Unless both sides don’t move, there is no deal.
fix.right: Unless both sides move, there is no deal.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com Were…to: “If the mayor offered a review, the union would return.”
rewrite.answer: Were the mayor to offer a review, the union would return.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com Should: “If the union accepts, we will sign.”
rewrite.answer: Should the union accept, we will sign.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com Had: “If talks had begun earlier, we would have won.”
rewrite.answer: Had talks begun earlier, we would have won.
